SVP Church Gate Collection Our SVP Church Gate Collection will be back on the 3rd Sunday of every

Thank you for your kindness and generosity, may God bless you and your families for always standing by
those most in need.

Sunday, 23rd August 2026
21st Sunday in Ordinary Time
Thoughts on the Gospel
“You are Peter, and on this rock I will build my Church.” — Matthew 16:18
In today’s Gospel, Jesus asks His disciples a very personal question about who they
believe He is. Many people had different opinions about Him, but Jesus wanted His
followers to speak from their own faith and experience.
Peter answers with confidence, recognising Jesus as the promised Saviour and the Son
of God.
This passage reminds us that faith cannot depend only on what others believe. We may
learn about God from our parents, teachers, friends or church community, but each of
us must eventually make our own response to Jesus.
🪨 Remember the word ROCK
R — RECOGNISE Jesus as Lord and Saviour.
O — OWN our faith through our daily choices.
C — COMMIT to the calling God gives us.
K — KEEP standing firm when life becomes difficult.
Peter was not perfect, yet Jesus still used him for a great purpose. In the same way, God
can work through our weaknesses and help us become part of His mission.

Booking Masses, Baptisms and Weddings As parish office opening hours have been reduced
slightly, we are returning to our previous practice of booking Masses, baptisms and weddings in
person, in the sacristy after Masses.
Masses can be booked well in advance to ensure your preferred dates are available.
Baptisms can only be booked by the child’s parent or legal guardian. At least one month’s notice is
required. To book a baptism parents must present the child’s long birth cert ificate , complete the
baptism request form, meet with one of our Baptism team and attend weekly Mass during the
month prior to the date of the Baptism
Weddings can be booked by the couple themselves. Couples are required to give at least six
months’ notic e of marriage to ensure the preferred date is available and that there is adequate time
to complete all Civil and Church paperwork.
